question: 決定：「合併前擋下沒人問過的合併」這份設計進入實作嗎？核准即接受 D1（Codex 上沒有紀錄的合併一律拒絕，由你親手合併）與 D2（套件出 merge_guard.py 腳本，由你在每台機器的使用者設定裡註冊，不出 plugin hook）兩個建議。

artifacts.summary: POC on both hosts in isolated state (ideation report, Opus, 2026-11-06): Claude hook ask prompts a person under auto and becomes a denial headless; Codex ignores ask silently, so only deny stops a merge; replay over #672 and 83 later merges stops #672 and 29 others (10 Release, 9 sync, 11 other), passes 54. Design: package merge_guard.py, user-level registration per host, ADR reserved at dispatch. D1-D2 coupled.
